newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia says sell-offs raise $80 million.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia says sell-offs raise $80 million.

text.p: Ethiopia said on Wednesday it had sold 133 firms at a cost of over $80 million in its privatisation drive of state-owned enterprises.
The general manager of the Ethiopian Privatisation Agency, Beshah Azmte, said the privatisation programme included leather, shoe, flour and sisal factories.
Beshah said some employees in the privatised firms have agreed to work under the new owners while others opted to be organised under the state supported safty net projects.
Some employees have formed associations and purchased shares and have become part owners of the firms being privatised, he added.
He did not reveal, however, what plan the government has to pay compensation to firms which were confisicated by the former Marxist regime of Mengistu Haile Mariam.
